items.meaning: 心无杂念的；心境纯净的

items.pattern: Today I want to find out ...
If the spell worked in the temple, why did it fail at home?
items.meaning: 如果法术在道观里有效，为什么回家后失灵了？

items.pattern: What did the master mean by 'keep your heart clean'?
items.meaning: 师父所说的“保持内心纯净”是什么意思？

items.pattern: Why would a woodcutter carry an ink stick?
items.meaning: 一个樵夫为什么会带着墨锭？

items.pattern: Why does he write the character 'Tong' again and again?
items.meaning: 他为什么一遍又一遍地写“童”字？

items.pattern: If his essay was good, why did he fail?
items.meaning: 如果他的文章写得不错，他为什么还是落第了？
有什么证据支持这个解释？
